mapper.select: SELECT TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(A.SMLT_ACTL_DT, 'HH24')) AS HOUR, SUM(A.WTNG_PSG_CNT) AS WAIT_PSG_CNT FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_RSLT_DTL A INNER JOIN PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_PSG_FCLT B ON A.PSG_FCLT_CD = B.PSG_FCLT_CD WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.SMLT_ID = #{smltId} AND B.TMNL_ID = #{tmnlId} AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.WTNG_PSG_CNT > 0 AND B.UP_PSG_FCLT_CD IN (#{item}) GROUP BY TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(A.SMLT_ACTL_DT, 'HH24')) ORDER BY HOUR

SELECT ROUND(AVG(A.AVG_WTNG_HR)) AS AVG_WTNG_HR, ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY A.AVG_WTNG_HR)) AS P95_WTNG_HR, MAX(A.WTNG_PSG_CNT) AS MAX_WTNG_PSG_CNT FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_RSLT_DTL A INNER JOIN PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_PSG_FCLT B ON A.PSG_FCLT_CD = B.PSG_FCLT_CD WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.SMLT_ID = #{smltId} AND B.TMNL_ID = #{tmnlId} AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.WTNG_PSG_CNT > 0 AND B.UP_PSG_FCLT_CD IN (#{item})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PMOWN.TH_PM_SMLT_FLFMT_HSTRY (SMLT_ID, SMLT_TYPE, SMLT_FLFMT_STTS_CD, FRST_RGTR_ID, FRST_REG_DT) VALUES (#{smltId}, #{smltType}, #{smltFlfmtSttsCd}, #{loginUserId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT A.SMLT_ID, A.SMLT_TYPE, A.EXCN_YMD, NVL((SELECT MIN(S.TMNL_ID) FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_STNG S WHERE S.SMLT_ID=A.SMLT_ID), 'P01') AS TMNL_ID, CASE A.SMLT_STTS WHEN 'Finished' THEN 'DONE' WHEN 'Failed' THEN 'FAILED' ELSE 'RUNNING' END AS SMLT_FLFMT_STTS_CD, TO_CHAR(A.SMLT_BGNG_DT, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS SMLT_FLFMT_BGNG_DT, TO_CHAR(A.SMLT_END_DT, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS SMLT_FLFMT_END_DT, NVL(ROUND((CAST(A.SMLT_END_DT AS DATE) - CAST(A.SMLT_BGNG_DT AS DATE)) * 1440), 0) AS EXEC_MIN, A.FRST_RGTR_ID AS RGTR_ID, NVL(C.USER_NM, '') AS USER_NM, NVL(D.DEPT_NM, '') AS DEPT_NM FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_MSTR A LEFT JOIN CAOWN.TN_CA_USER C ON A.FRST_RGTR_ID = C.USER_ID LEFT JOIN CAOWN.TN_CA_DEPT D ON C.DEPT_CD = D.DEPT_CD WHERE A.SMLT_ID = #{smltId}

SELECT A.SMLT_ID, A.SMLT_TYPE, A.EXCN_YMD, NVL((SELECT MIN(S.TMNL_ID) FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_STNG S WHERE S.SMLT_ID=A.SMLT_ID), 'P01') AS TMNL_ID, CASE A.SMLT_STTS WHEN 'Finished' THEN 'DONE' WHEN 'Failed' THEN 'FAILED' ELSE 'RUNNING' END AS SMLT_FLFMT_STTS_CD, TO_CHAR(A.SMLT_BGNG_DT, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS SMLT_FLFMT_BGNG_DT, TO_CHAR(A.SMLT_END_DT, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS SMLT_FLFMT_END_DT, NVL(ROUND((CAST(A.SMLT_END_DT AS DATE) - CAST(A.SMLT_BGNG_DT AS DATE)) * 1440), 0) AS EXEC_MIN, A.FRST_RGTR_ID AS RGTR_ID, NVL(C.USER_NM, '') AS USER_NM, NVL(D.DEPT_NM, '') AS DEPT_NM FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_MSTR A LEFT JOIN CAOWN.TN_CA_USER C ON A.FRST_RGTR_ID = C.USER_ID LEFT JOIN CAOWN.TN_CA_DEPT D ON C.DEPT_CD = D.DEPT_CD WHERE TO_CHAR(NVL(A.SMLT_REQ_DT, A.SMLT_BGNG_DT), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MI') BETWEEN #{bgnDt} AND #{endDt} ORDER BY NVL(A.SMLT_REQ_DT, A.SMLT_BGNG_DT) DESC, A.SMLT_ID DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) TOT_CNT, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN SMLT_STTS = 'Finished' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) DONE_CNT, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN SMLT_STTS IN ('New', 'Executing') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) RUNNING_CNT, NVL(ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN SMLT_STTS = 'Finished' THEN (CAST(SMLT_END_DT AS DATE) - CAST(SMLT_BGNG_DT AS DATE)) * 86400 END)), 0) AVG_EXEC_SEC FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_MSTR WHERE TO_CHAR(NVL(SMLT_REQ_DT, SMLT_BGNG_DT), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MI') BETWEEN #{bgnDt} AND #{endDt}
